lines: track/c-maturity rebased on main 03891a3 (after e-reviews and c-payment-sheet): b887f54 feat(maturity) backend+contracts+migration 065+generated; d767ec6 feat(admin-ui) dashboard, hub section, resolve dialog, launch prompt; ae82558 fix(maturity) review follow-up. Not landed, not pushed.

Rebase resolutions: generator/index keep CLIENT_REVIEW, RECORDING_SHEET and ADMIN_MATURITY_SCHEDULE operation sets; queryKeys keep recordingSheet and maturity keys; adminComposition keeps the recording-sheet and maturity-schedule registrations; adminRoutes keeps payment-sheet and maturities routes; generated OpenAPI and operations.ts regenerated by script at each step (177 ops), no drift at tip; releaseUpgrade expects ...063, 064, 065, 066, 067.

Migration 065 (expand-only, new table): client_maturity_schedules(user, fund, maturity_date 2000..2199, state scheduled|resolved|cancelled, resolution return_all|one_time_and_sip|sip_reinvestment, maturity_id -> client_position_maturities(id,user,fund), follow_up_sip_schedule_id -> admin_sip_schedules(id,user,fund), actor, version, timestamps). One scheduled row per (user,fund); unique maturity_id; shape and resolution-link checks; trigger keeps resolved/cancelled rows unchanged and refuses delete/truncate.
Contract admin-maturity-schedules.ts (7 ops). Reads: client_position.write or client_values.read. Writes: client_position.write + CSRF + Idempotency-Key; resolve receipts durable.

GET /v1/admin/maturities (keyset by maturity date, state filter); GET /v1/admin/maturities/due (asOf today IST, dueThrough +30 days, overdue included); GET/POST /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/maturity-schedules; PATCH .../{scheduleId}; POST .../cancel; POST .../resolve.

Resolve order: position lock -> refuse if a client_position_maturities row for the holding was settled at or after the schedule's created_at (hand-settled in the Maturity tab; message points to Cancel) -> refuse before the maturity date (IST) -> resolution.

(1) return_all: amountPaise must equal the current value; mark matured (maturedOn = settlement date, or reuse an open pending maturity) + existing withdrawal + pending payout. Zero-value holding refused with a pointer to Cancel.

(2) one_time_and_sip: body now carries expectedPrincipalPaise and expectedCurrentValuePaise; any mismatch under the lock -> STATE_CONFLICT, nothing written. Growth != 0 -> existing reinvestment (a loss is written into principal only because the admin confirmed those exact figures; the dialog says so plainly); growth 0 -> no ledger row. Then close the active SIP for client+fund and create the new one.
(3) sip_reinvestment: no ledger row, no maturity row; close active SIP + create new one. MAINTAINER MUST CONFIRM this money flow.
SIP start month for (2)/(3) must be after the maturity month AND not before the current IST month.

Dialog: shows current value, amount invested, gain or loss, and the active SIP it would close (monthly amount, months paid, months remaining); options 2/3 blocked while SIP schedules are unread; after a STATE_CONFLICT the queries refetch (awaited in onSettled) and confirm stays disabled while refetching; the held key is released only on a definitive refusal, kept on unknown.

Checks at tip ae82558 (Node 22 container): contracts check 98 tests, OpenAPI valid, 177 ops reachable; backend check 100 files/1198; integration 57 files/519 (coverage off); frontend check 34 files/316; build:client + build:admin boot checks. Commit bodies of b887f54/d767ec6 cite counts measured before the rebase onto 03891a3; commit 1 frontend alone was checked before the rebase.

Tests: maturitySchedules.integration (9: dates and no money, permissions, IST due window, return all, one-time atomic with failure injection proving the reinvestment write happened before the injected SIP failure via a non-transactional sequence and that ledger, maturity, SIP and audit rows roll back, start-month floors, zero growth and SIP reinvest, value update between read and confirm, hand-settled refusal, unreached date); clientMaturityScheduleMigration.integration (2).

Negative controls (each failed its own test): amount check off; UTC asOf; SIP close skipped; hasOpen off; unreached guard off; expected-figures check off (200 not 409); current-month floor off (200 not 400); hand-settled check off (200 not 409).

Conservative defaults for plan 0a: due window 30 days; resolution only on/after the maturity date; settlement date defaults to the maturity date; SIP start month after the maturity month and not before the current month; (2)/(3) close any active SIP for the fund; set/edit/cancel send no client notice; hand-settled detection = settled maturity at or after the date was set.
Not done: plan doc section 8 (coordinator), browser/device runs, APK export, VPS.

Migration 065 (expand-only, new table only, previous release ignores it): client_maturity_schedules(id,user_id,fund_id,maturity_date 2000-01-01..2199-12-31,state scheduled|resolved|cancelled,resolution return_all|one_time_and_sip|sip_reinvestment,maturity_id,follow_up_sip_schedule_id,created_by/updated_by,request_id,version,created/updated/resolved/cancelled_at).

065 constraints: shape check per state; resolution_links check (return_all needs maturity_id and no SIP; sip_reinvestment needs SIP and no maturity; one_time_and_sip needs SIP, maturity optional); composite FKs to client_position_maturities(id,user,fund) and admin_sip_schedules(id,user,fund); partial unique one scheduled row per (user,fund); unique maturity_id; trigger refuses delete/truncate and any update of a resolved or cancelled row.
maturity_settlement enum and AdminMaturity untouched. releaseUpgrade expects ...063, 064, 065, 066, 067 and client_maturity_schedules empty.

Contract packages/contracts/src/operations/admin-maturity-schedules.ts (ADMIN_MATURITY_SCHEDULE_OPERATIONS, 7 ops). Read perms client_position.write or client_values.read; writes client_position.write + CSRF + required Idempotency-Key (resolve uses durable receipt retention).
GET /v1/admin/maturities?state=&after=&limit= dashboard, keyset via keysetBoundary on (maturity_date as UTC timestamptz, id) ascending, cursor bound to state; default state scheduled.
GET /v1/admin/maturities/due?limit= -> {asOf, dueThrough, windowDays:30, total, items}: scheduled rows with maturity_date <= today in India + 30 days, overdue included.

GET/POST /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/maturity-schedules; PATCH .../{scheduleId} (expectedVersion, maturityDate); POST .../{scheduleId}/cancel; POST .../{scheduleId}/resolve (discriminated by resolution).

Item: scheduleId,userId,clientName,fundId,fundName,maturityDate,state(string),resolution(string|null),dueStatus overdue|due_soon|upcoming|closed (string),daysUntil,maturityId,followUpSipScheduleId,version,createdAt,updatedAt,resolvedAt,cancelledAt.

Set requires a held position (findPositionBasis) and an active/suspended client account (requireRecordableClient); future dates allowed. Lock order everywhere: position advisory lock -> maturity row FOR UPDATE -> user row -> SIP row (same order as recordings).

Resolve refuses before the maturity date (IST), with a stale version, or on a resolved/cancelled row. effectiveDate must be >= maturity date and <= today; markPositionMatured uses maturedOn = effectiveDate; an existing open pending maturity (old MaturityPanel) is reused instead.

(1) return_all: amountPaise must equal the current value exactly (else 409, nothing written); mark matured + withdrawMaturedPosition for the full value -> one withdrawal entry, one pending withdrawal_operations payout, maturity settled 'withdrawal', schedule linked. No bank transfer.

(2) one_time_and_sip: growth != 0 -> mark matured + reinvestMaturedPosition (principal += growth, value 0, maturity settled 'reinvestment'); growth == 0 -> no ledger row and no maturity row. Then closeAdminSipSchedule on any active SIP for client+fund and createAdminSipSchedule (start month must be after the maturity month). One transaction.

(3) sip_reinvestment: no form in the existing settlement types fits (withdrawal implies a payout, reinvestment is the lump sum of option 2), so: no ledger row, no maturity row, close active SIP + create new one. MAINTAINER MUST CONFIRM this money flow (admin records each month as usual; the matured money is not re-recorded).
Audit commands client_maturity_schedule.created/updated/cancelled/resolved, metadata always carries userId (066 index). No client notification beyond the existing settlement notices.

Frontend: features/admin/maturities/* (maturityQueries.ts holds all hooks; adminQueries.ts untouched at 511). /maturities route + nav (client-values, order 6.7), ClientMaturitySection after SipScheduleSection on UserDetailScreen, MaturityResolveDialog, MaturityDuePrompt in AdminFrame (dismissal in memory per signed-in admin id; failed due read opens the prompt with the error state).

Shared edits: adminComposition (one maturityRepository shared), db/types.ts, contracts index+generator, queryKeys (+4), adminRoutes (+route, link map maturities->user-detail), HeldWriteNotice FIELD_LABELS (+6).

Checks (Node 22 container, at the final tree): contracts check 98 tests, OpenAPI valid, 176 ops reachable; backend check 100 files/1198; integration 56 files/512 (coverage off); frontend check 32 files/303; build:client + build:admin boot checks. Commit 1 frontend alone: typecheck, lint, 303 tests, generate:api:check.
New tests: maturitySchedules.integration (7) and clientMaturityScheduleMigration.integration (2, populated upgrade + DB checks).
Negative controls: no amount check -> return-all test 200 not 409; UTC asOf -> due window test; no SIP close -> one-time test 409; no hasOpen -> 500 not 409; no unreached-date guard -> 200 not 409.

Conservative defaults for plan 0a: due window 30 days; resolution only on/after the maturity date; settlement date defaults to the maturity date; new SIP start month after the maturity month; (2)/(3) close any active SIP for the fund; set/edit/cancel send no client notice.
